name: dash (sh)
licence: BSD-3-Clause (some files carry other licences; see the Debian copyright file)
why-we-use-it: The POSIX shell orgfs is tested under; small, strict, no bashisms.

name: busybox (ash)
why-we-use-it: A second small shell and set of utilities, so we know orgfs does not lean on GNU extras.

name: gawk
why-we-use-it: One of the two awks the declaration parser and site renderer are tested under.

name: mawk
why-we-use-it: The other tested awk; its smaller feature set keeps the awk code portable.

name: GNU coreutils
why-we-use-it: sha256sum, dd, sort, cut, tr, wc and cp do the byte work.

name: GNU make
why-we-use-it: Runs the check, prove-red, site and demo targets.

name: git
why-we-use-it: Holds the history of this project and its declarations.

name: Python 3 (tests only)
why-we-use-it: Drives the black-box tests from a second language; the tool itself needs no Python.

name: dehydrated
why-we-use-it: Obtains and renews the site certificate.

name: OpenSSH (sshfs transport)
licence: BSD-style, several variants (see the LICENCE file in the OpenSSH source)
why-we-use-it: Carries the remote mounts that the sshfs transport reads and writes through.

name: sshfs
why-we-use-it: Provides the mounts under /spokes; licence not yet confirmed from its own source.

name: Debian GNU/Linux
licence: Mixed: every package carries its own DFSG-free licence
why-we-use-it: The operating system the hosts run; its packages are the ones listed above.

name: Proxmox VE
why-we-use-it: The hypervisor under the hosts; exact licence version wording not yet confirmed.

name: GitHub Actions runner
why-we-use-it: Runs the CI on a machine we host.
